messages:
Zoe (docs): FYI ran a focused pass on the Dedicated provisioning section. Found 5 inconsistent example tokens, one broken include, and an outdated SDK snippet that still references ClientV1. Planning a single PR to: normalize field names to v2, add a migration table, update snippets, and add a minimal autoscale example.

link-fix-bot: Scan results: 5 mismatched tokens (autoscale/reserved_pool/ClientV1), 1 broken include (#provisioning-timelines-old). Report: https://ci.internal/doc-scans/4967890123

Marco (eng): Thanks Zoe. We agreed on 'scalePolicy' and 'reserved_capacity' in runtime v2. Please standardize examples and add a short migration mapping. Also add a one-line note: scaling to 0 drops in-memory KV caches.

Zoe (docs): Draft migration mapping (single-line rows): autoscale.threshold -> scalePolicy.target_utilization_pct; autoscale.cooldown -> scalePolicy.cooldown_seconds; reserved_pool -> reserved_capacity; ClientV1 -> ProvisioningClient (v2).

Hana (infra): Old anchor was moved during the handbook split. I can add a redirect in infra-docs if you list the old id. I'll add a 301 meta and update static includes.

Zoe (docs): Old include/id: #provisioning-timelines-old -> new id #provisioning-timeline. I'll update include refs and link to your redirect PR in mine.

Priyanka (product): Can we include a tiny SLA line about provisioning latency? Something like: "Reserved capacity typically provisions in 2-5 minutes; during peak it may take up to 10 minutes." Keep it terse.

Marco (eng): Good. Also add a sentence that reserved_capacity warming is billed immediately and instances may take a short time to reach ready state.

Zoe (docs): Minimal autoscale YAML for examples/autoscale/minimal.yaml:
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization_pct: 70
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 8
```
And a compact Python v2 snippet: 
```python
# redwood-sdk v2
from redwood import ProvisioningClient
client = ProvisioningClient()
policy = {"scalePolicy": {"mode": "target_utilization", "target_utilization_pct": 70}}
client.tenants.update_scale("$TENANT_ID", policy)
```
Small TS one-liner: `await client.tenants.updateScale($TENANT_ID, policy)`

Marco (eng): Nice. Add a short comment pointing users to replace $TENANT_ID and to use env vars for creds. Also mention autoscale -> scalePolicy rename explicitly in a tiny callout.

Hana (infra): I'll open infra-docs PR for the redirect and post link here once ready.

Zoe (docs): Opening docs PR now including migration table, updated examples, CLI snippets, and the one-line SLA & cache note. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5125 

Priyanka (product): Assigning a quick staging smoke: apply minimal.yaml to staging tenant and confirm warm instances and expected provisioning latency. I'll run after merge.

link-fix-bot: Scheduled re-scan after PR merge to confirm no legacy tokens remain.

Marco (eng): I'll do a quick review; should be a small change. If green, merge and notify infra to merge redirects.

Hana (infra): Redirect PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-docs/pull/1150 — linked in docs PR comments.

Zoe (docs): Thanks everyone. I'll close thread after merge + re-scan.
